name: codereview-plugin
description: Consent-based semantic review of staged commits using Open Code Review delegation or a configured OCR model; findings remain advisory.

interface.shortDescription: Review staged commits with explicit consent
interface.longDescription: 通过 Open Code Review 选择候选文件和规则，默认由当前宿主智能体审查，也可使用 OCR-managed 模式；提供结构化建议，不替代流程验收或静态检查。
defaultPrompt: 请披露代码外发范围，再询问是否审查本次提交。
